name: wasteless-ai
description: WasteLess AI — household food-waste-reduction assistant (Expo Web + Android + Fastify API)

scripts.build:server: npm --workspace=@wasteless/core run build && npm --workspace=@wasteless/server run build
scripts.build:web: npm --workspace=@wasteless/core run build && npm --workspace=app run export:web
scripts.dev:server: npm --workspace=@wasteless/core run build && npm --workspace=@wasteless/server run dev
scripts.dev:app: npm --workspace=@wasteless/core run build && npm --workspace=app run start
scripts.dev:web: npm --workspace=@wasteless/core run build && npm --workspace=app run web
scripts.test: npm --workspace=@wasteless/core run test && npm --workspace=@wasteless/server run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@wasteless/core run typecheck && npm --workspace=@wasteless/server run typecheck && npm --workspace=app run typecheck
